item.title: 'Avatar' Officially Unveils a Very Different Version of Zuko in New Book
item.description: 2026 has been a fantastic year to be a fan of the Avatar franchise — the elemental fantasy saga, not the blue alien sci-fi movies. The animated sequel series Avatar: Seven Havens has been phenomenally successful, with a second season already confirmed, and Paramount Studios even has an Avatar fighting game that actually feels great to play. However, arguably the biggest win for Avatar fans this year was Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender . Set 12 years after Avatar: The Last Airbender ended, the movie reunited the gang for a new adventure. And even though it didn't get a theatrical release as originally promised, it was still a win for Team Avatar.

item.title: All active Escape From Tarkov codes and rewards
item.description: Escape From Tarkov promo codes are used in the classic extraction shooter for all sorts of rewards. From in-game gear and weapons to currency, cosmetics, and more, redeeming as many of these Tarkov codes as you can will set you up for your next raid. Especially since these goodies don't actually require a successful extraction to obtain them.

item.title: GTA 6 Presales Are 'Running Far in Excess of Our Expectations,' Take-Two Interactive CEO Says
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most anticipated releases of this decade, so it's no surprise that it's selling like hotcakes before it's even out. In this fiscal quarter's earnings presentation , the CEO of developer Take-Two Interactive revealed that pre-orders "are tracking far above initial expectations". However, GTA 6' s success might also be the reason Take-Two's other game series failed to meet target sales.

item.title: James Gunn’s Exit from DC Studios Was Due to Tensions with Skydance's Executives, Report Says
item.description: It’s been just over four years since James Gunn and Peter Safran took the reins at DC Studios as co-CEOs. For fans impressed by Gunn’s Marvel films, including Guardians of the Galaxy, the prospect of what Gunn and Safran could bring to DC comics adaptations across film, animation, and television was especially exciting.

item.title: A Sci-Fi Novel Just Won the Booker Prize for the First Time
item.description: M. John Harrison's The End of Everything was awarded the 2026 Booker Prize. This marks the first time that a sci-fi novel has won the prestigious literary award for works of fiction in English published in the United Kingdom or Ireland.

item.title: Warhammer Survivors Isn’t Good Enough to Be a Vampire Survivors Replacement
item.description: Vampire Survivors and its plethora of clones are always more fun in hour ten than hour one. The passive nature of the auto-attack gameplay means this style of experience lives or dies by how fun and visually over-the-top the action can get once you upgrade your character, gain access to more weapons, and manage to survive long enough to level up or evolve your weapons.

item.title: Nintendo Adds eShop Gifting to Switch Consoles
item.description: The latest Nintendo Switch system update added support for an upcoming feature that will let users gift digital software purchased through the eShop. The gifting system is set to launch this month, meaning Switch users will be able to add digital games to their letters to Santa this festive season.

item.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Exposes the Biggest Problem with Christopher Nolan's World War II Epic
item.description: Notably, neither movie actually depicted those nuclear explosions or their immediate aftermath onscreen, but three years later, one of those directors has done exactly that — and it's not Nolan.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Dinosaurs That Prove Gary Larson Is a Mad Genius
item.description: The Far Side ran from 1980 until 1995 and Larson created over 4,000 strips during that time. Dozens of them featured dinosaurs.

item.title: The Settlers of Catan Movie Has Finally Found Its Directors
item.description: Netflix's upcoming adaptation of The Settlers of Catan is starting to take shape, with the popular board game officially one step closer to becoming a live-action movie. The streaming service has tapped a film-making duo to director the film — the first official move from the project since it was announced.
